primary-50.$description: Brand slot. Defaults to gray-50. Replace primary-50…950 with your own ramp; components only read the action-* tokens below, which alias this ramp.

primary-100.$description: Brand slot. Defaults to gray-100. Replace primary-50…950 with your own ramp; components only read the action-* tokens below, which alias this ramp.

primary-200.$description: Brand slot. Defaults to gray-200. Replace primary-50…950 with your own ramp; components only read the action-* tokens below, which alias this ramp.

space-2.$description: Hairline nudges only: focus-ring offset, badge dot gaps. The one sub-4 step.

space-4.$description: Half-step: icon-to-label gap in small controls, tight stacks.

space-8.$description: Base unit. Gap between related items; icon-to-label in buttons.

space-12.$description: Input horizontal padding; compact list rows.

space-16.$description: Default padding in cards and modals (mobile); gap between form fields.

space-32.$description: Section padding inside pages; modal padding on desktop.

space-96.$description: Top-level page spacing on wide screens.

radius-sm.$description: DEFAULT for components: buttons, inputs, checkboxes, tags, tooltips, menus.

radius-lg.$description: Bottom sheets, large panels, app-icon-like tiles.

size-icon-sm.$description: Icons in small controls and inline text.

size-touch-ios.$description: Minimum touch target on iOS (Apple HIG).

border-2.$description: Focus ring, selected card, checked outlines.

duration-slower.$description: Page transitions, skeleton shimmer cycle half.

ease-standard.$description: Default for anything that moves on screen.

opacity-hover.$description: State layer on hover over custom-coloured fills.

opacity-pressed.$description: State layer on press over custom-coloured fills.

sans.$value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

mono.$value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

display-xl.$description: Hero headlines on marketing pages (desktop only; use display-lg ≤ md).

heading-1.$description: One per page: the page title.

body.$description: Default text. Never smaller for paragraphs on web.

body-sm.$description: Dense UI: tables, helper text, secondary info.

caption.$description: Timestamps, footnotes, chart labels. Not for sentences longer than one line.

label.$description: Buttons, form labels, tabs, menu items.

surface-raised.$description: Modals, popovers, toasts (pair with a shadow).

surface-sunken.$description: Wells, code blocks, track of sliders/progress.

surface-hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

surface-pressed.$description: Pressed fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

border.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines (not for controls).

border-strong.$description: Input, checkbox and radio borders — ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

text.$description: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised (18.9:1 light, 17:1 dark).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, helper text, captions on bg/surface (≥6.7:1).

text-subtle.$description: Placeholders, metadata on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Not for body copy.

text-inverse.$description: Text on surface-inverse and on action.

action.$description: Primary button fill, selected states, switch on, checkbox checked. Brand slot: light reads primary-950.

focus-ring.$description: 2px focus outline with a 2px offset in bg colour — ≥3:1 against every surface.

link.$description: Links are ink + underline; never colour alone.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive actions. Text and icons on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Always pair with an icon or word.

danger-solid.$description: Solid fill (badges, filled alerts, destructive button).

danger-bg.$description: Tinted background for danger alerts and fields.

danger-border.$description: Border of danger alerts; error-state input border uses `danger`.

warning.$description: Caution, pending risk. Text and icons on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Always pair with an icon or word.

warning-solid.$description: Solid fill (badges, filled alerts, destructive button).

warning-bg.$description: Tinted background for warning alerts and fields.

warning-border.$description: Border of warning alerts; error-state input border uses `warning`.

success.$description: Completion, positive status. Text and icons on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Always pair with an icon or word.

success-solid.$description: Solid fill (badges, filled alerts, destructive button).

success-bg.$description: Tinted background for success alerts and fields.

success-border.$description: Border of success alerts; error-state input border uses `success`.

info.$description: Neutral information, tips. Text and icons on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Always pair with an icon or word.

info-bg.$description: Tinted background for info alerts and fields.

info-border.$description: Border of info alerts; error-state input border uses `info`.
